nodes.title: 📖 READ ME
widgets_values:
## HunyuanImage 3.0 — All-in-One

One workflow for all 5 official workflows: **Instruct-Distil, Instruct and Base**, text-to-image, **image editing**, **multi-image fusion (up to 3)**, **prompt rewriting** and **Spectrum** speed-up.

### Quick start
1. **① Models** – pick your model file.
2. **④ Control Panel → model type** – set it to **match** the file you picked (sets steps + CFG for you).
3. Type in **② Prompt** and press **Run**.

### Toggles (Control Panel)
| Toggle | What it does |
|---|---|
| **edit mode** | Off = text → image. On = edit / combine the images in ③ |
| **use image 2 / 3** | Add a 2nd / 3rd input image (edit mode) |
| **output size from image 1** | Edit mode: keep image 1's shape. Off = use **resolution** |
| **resolution** | Size for text → image (trained ~1 MP sizes) |
| **prompt rewriting** | Model expands your prompt first. **Slow: ~4–5 min extra** |
| **spectrum speed-up** | ~3.4× faster for Instruct/Base, small detail drift |
| **distil guidance** | Distil only. Keep 2.5 |
| **steps override** | 0 = automatic (8 / 50 / 50) |

### Tips
- Edit prompts: say *"the first image"*, *"the second image"*.
- Edit with a **different seed** than the one that made the input image.
- **Base** = text → image only (no edit, no rewrite).
- Need bigger? Generate ~1 MP, then upscale (SeedVR2 etc).

### Files (from HuggingFace, PedroMarinhoDev)
| File | Folder |
|---|---|
| hunyuan_image_3_instruct_distil_w4a8.safetensors | models/diffusion_models |
| vae/hunyuan_image_3_vae_fp16.safetensors | models/vae |
| clip_vision/hunyuan_image_3_instruct_distil_siglip2_so400m_naflex.safetensors | models/clip_vision |
| hunyuan_image_3_instruct_distil_cot_head.safetensors (rewriting only) | models/diffusion_models |

[Distil](https://huggingface.co/PedroMarinhoDev/HunyuanImage-3.0-Instruct-Distil-ComfyUI) · [Instruct](https://huggingface.co/PedroMarinhoDev/HunyuanImage-3.0-Instruct-ComfyUI) · [Base](https://huggingface.co/PedroMarinhoDev/HunyuanImage-3.0-Base-ComfyUI)

**64 GB RAM:** use **W4A8 only** and close other apps. ComfyUI needs ~50 GB free RAM.

Nodes: [ComfyUI-HunyuanImage3](https://github.com/PedroMarinhoDev/ComfyUI-HunyuanImage3) by Pedro Marinho. Double-click the Control Panel to see the wiring inside.
